About the role

We are hiring a Senior Director of Content Design to lead the content
design practice across our consumer banking products. You will lead an
existing team of six content designers and UX writers, own the content
standards every product surface follows, and sit on the design
leadership team alongside the heads of product design and research.

What you'll do

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of content designers and UX writers:
  career growth, craft development, and a high bar for the writing that
  ships.
- Own the voice, terminology, and content standards for the mobile and
  web banking experience, and the system that keeps them coherent.
- Raise the bar on content craft through critique, workshops, and
  hands-on editing alongside the team.
- Partner with product design, research, legal, and accessibility to
  make complex financial moments plain and humane.
- Shape how the practice adopts AI-assisted writing tools without
  lowering the standard of what ships.
- Keep the practice steady: one domain, owned deeply, improved release
  over release.

What we're looking for

- 10+ years of content design or UX writing experience, with 5+ years
  leading content design teams
- A record of developing writers and content designers into bigger
  roles
- Fluency partnering with design systems teams; you treat terminology
  and components as one system
- Experience making regulated, high-stakes flows clear without losing
  warmth
- Comfort operating at the leadership table: planning, headcount, and
  standards are yours to own

What we offer

- Flexible, hybrid-friendly work with an async-first default
- A written commitment to sustainable pace, backed by real policies
- Comprehensive health coverage, parental leave, and retirement
  matching

The salary range for this position is $170,000 - $210,000 annually.
